chapters.fraternity_name: Lambda Phi Epsilon International Fraternity, Inc.

universities.research_notes: Primary source is the official SFL 'Chapters' directory (sfl.osu.edu/about-us/chapters/), which lists 61 total recognized organizations across IFC/PHA/NPHC/MGC but does not display a per-item council tag in the automated page render (the tag is behind a client-side filter that could not be triggered via automated tools). Council assignment for each org above was inferred from standard national-organization naming conventions (men's NIC fraternities = IFC; 'Fraternity, Inc.' Divine Nine orgs = NPHC; culturally-based orgs = MGC) and cross-validated: the inferred IFC count (26) exactly matches the independently reported 'IFC is made up of 26 chapters' figure from a January 2026 Ohio State student-newspaper (The Lantern) article, giving high confidence in the classification. NPHC/MGC fraternity counts were not independently corroborated by a second source and could theoretically include recently inactive orgs; treat NPHC/MGC entries as directionally reliable but slightly lower confidence than the IFC list. Sororities (PHA/NPHC/MGC) appearing on the same official page were excluded per scope (fraternities only).

universities.name: Howard University
universities.party_life_notes: Howard is a historically Black university and the founding site of the National Pan-Hellenic Council (NPHC, the 'Divine Nine') in 1930; it does not have a traditional IFC in the sense used at predominantly white institutions — its Greek life is organized entirely around NPHC member organizations.
universities.research_notes: Howard University's own Student Affairs page lists all ten NPHC-affiliated chapters (undergraduate) present at Howard, including the four NPHC sororities (Alpha Kappa Alpha - Alpha Chapter, Delta Sigma Theta - Alpha Chapter, Sigma Gamma Rho - Alpha Phi Chapter, Zeta Phi Beta - Alpha Chapter), which are excluded here as this batch scopes to fraternities only. The page also listed a 'Kappa Alpha Psi — Theta Tau Graduate Chapter,' which was excluded from this list as a graduate/alumni chapter rather than an active undergraduate chapter (Kappa Alpha Psi's undergraduate Xi Chapter is included above). Howard has no traditional NIC-affiliated IFC — all its recognized Greek organizations are NPHC (Divine Nine), several of which (Alpha Phi Alpha, Omega Psi Phi, Phi Beta Sigma) were founded or hold their national 'Alpha' (founding) chapter at Howard.
